title: When Are You Really an Adult?
subtitle: In an age when the line between childhood and adulthood is blurrier than ever, what is it that makes people grown up?
description: Julie Beck examines how adulthood is defined across law, biology, culture, work, family roles, and personal responsibility, arguing that there is no single universal moment of arrival.
metadata_notes: The PDF is a local printout of Julie Beck's The Atlantic article published on January 5, 2016.
Article title, author, source, and publication year were confirmed from the source article.
